feedback: The geometry provides a stable and well-sensed platform with evenly spaced sensors that cover the tape line well. The moderate wheel track and radius balance speed and control effectively. The controller compensates well for the sensor layout with a smooth gradient of sensor weights, enabling good line position detection. The compact body and moderate mass help maintain stability without excessive inertia. The line loss recovery strategy 'search_left' should help regain the line when lost. Initial tuning expects moderate speed and low line loss, but future races will confirm performance and highlight any needed adjustments.
requested_changes: Increase sensor_size to 0.016 to improve line detection robustness
Adjust sensor_positions to spread sensors slightly wider (e.g., from ±0.04 to ±0.05) for better coverage
Increase base_speed to 1.2 to test higher speed capability while monitoring control stability
